questions.question: The sum of three consecutive whole numbers is 51. What is the smallest of the three numbers?
questions.explanation: Call the smallest n. Then the others are n + 1 and n + 2, so 3n + 3 = 51, giving 3n = 48 and n = 16. The three numbers are 16, 17, 18.

questions.subject: math
questions.question: A chemist has 18 litres of a 28% solution and a stock of 33% solution. How many litres of the 33% solution must be added to make the mixture 30%?
questions.explanation: The amount of dissolved substance is conserved. Adding x litres of 33% to 18 litres of 28% must give 30 litres at 30%: 33x + 28·18 = 30(x + 18), so x = 12 litres.

questions.question: A train travels 100 km in 5 hours at a constant speed. What is its average speed in km/h?
questions.explanation: Average speed is distance divided by time: 100 km / 5 h = 20 km/h. Dividing the other way round (5/100) is a common slip.
